import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_6.csv"
]

# Columns and their target dtypes as per target schema
target_columns = [
    'Timestamp [ms]',
    'CPU cores',
    'CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]',
    'CPU usage [MHZ]',
    'CPU usage [%]',
    'Memory capacity provisioned [KB]',
    'Memory usage [KB]',
    'Disk read throughput [KB/s]',
    'Disk write throughput [KB/s]',
    'Network received throughput [KB/s]',
    'Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]',
    'Timestamp'
]

# Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source DataFrames vertically
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are in the correct order and types as target schema (except 'Timestamp' which is string and not in sources)
union_df = union_df[target_columns[:-1]]  # all except 'Timestamp' column

# Convert columns to target types explicitly
union_df['Timestamp [ms]'] = union_df['Timestamp [ms]'].astype('int64')
union_df['CPU cores'] = union_df['CPU cores'].astype('int64')
union_df['CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]'] = union_df['CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]'].astype('float64')
union_df['CPU usage [MHZ]'] = union_df['CPU usage [MHZ]'].astype('float64')
union_df['CPU usage [%]'] = union_df['CPU usage [%]'].astype('float64')
union_df['Memory capacity provisioned [KB]'] = union_df['Memory capacity provisioned [KB]'].astype('int64')
union_df['Memory usage [KB]'] = union_df['Memory usage [KB]'].astype('float64')
union_df['Disk read throughput [KB/s]'] = union_df['Disk read throughput [KB/s]'].astype('int64')
union_df['Disk write throughput [KB/s]'] = union_df['Disk write throughput [KB/s]'].astype('float64')
union_df['Network received throughput [KB/s]'] = union_df['Network received throughput [KB/s]'].astype('float64')
union_df['Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]'] = union_df['Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]'].astype('float64')

# Create the 'Timestamp' string column from 'Timestamp [ms]'
# Convert milliseconds since epoch to datetime string in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
union_df['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(union_df['Timestamp [ms]'], unit='ms').dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
union_df = union_df[target_columns]

# Write the resulting DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/target_multisource.csv"
union_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
